text: Path of the room-form accounts changed, dated as departures.jsonl line 18 (18 lines; helper d5f_departure2.py), a history correction to line 17's scope: tools/checks/stage_D5.py (lines 439 to 443) refuses any forms/*-account.md without a branches-D5.jsonl line, and such a line must name a branch D4 cut (lines 124 to 127), so forms/room-form-A-account.md would fail every close of D5a-36 to D5a-41. I do not rename the file to escape the check's pattern. The accounts go to out/room-form-<letter>-account.md, their lines to out/room-forms-D5.jsonl; branches-D5.jsonl and forms/ untouched. To be reported to the PI in the final message.

D5a-36: template d5a36_template.md drafted; checked each typed claim against its source before filling, and found seven to correct (a superseding template follows, the draft kept): r/redhotchilipeppers was asked to move as the bigger sub (c0064), not the smaller; the r/clg quote is a neighbour's member (c0067); r/placetardis's speaker is a member, not shown as the organiser; r/FloydVsVoid's rival described from its model only (no album cover; the unrepresentative point is now the size of its record: 205 concepts against the defining median 99, 26 changes against 10), and no gendered pronoun; r/stardewvalley's trade is an offer (c0114) and the prior-claim request was put to one builder (c0036); section 16's falsification names only A04's two datings.
